verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS account that holds business documents, so this is not 'na'. The evidence shows only document storage, digital access, and viewing/sharing in the dashboard. Nothing documents a bulk 'export all my data' function, open export formats, or an account-exit and data-portability process. Cloud access and sharing are adjacent features, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
